svg.title: Retry with Backoff & Jitter
svg.desc: Retry with Backoff & Jitter. Retry transient failures with growing, randomised delays so clients don't stampede. Step 1, Retry what can succeed: A 503 is retried after a short wait and succeeds. A 429 waits for Retry-After. A 400 is not retried. Step 2, Immediate retries: Six calls arrive at once and time out. Retrying immediately keeps six in flight: a retry storm. Step 3, Exponential backoff: Waits double (100, 200, 400, 800 ms): far fewer attempts, but the six retries still arrive in waves. Step 4, Add jitter: Full jitter randomises each wait, so retries soon spread out under capacity and all six succeed.

g.text: A 503 is retried after a short wait and succeeds. A 429 waits for Retry-After. A 400 is not retried.

Full jitter randomises each wait, so retries soon spread out under capacity and all six succeed.
